text:
QUOTE: `batchRecords`, `processRecords`, `prepareRecords` and `handleRecords` all live on `BaseDataOperator`, so every server handler uses them.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says all server handlers use BaseDataOperator's batchRecords, but it never gives the mixin constraint (each mixin must extend ServerDataOperatorBase) as the reason. It also names two direct `database.write` sites that bypass `batchRecords`.
